one_line: JSON prompt packages for Nano Banana Pro, with a scored memory that keeps only the rules that work.
invariants: Zero runtime dependencies. Do not add a framework, a bundler, or a CSS library.
The browser never invents data. It renders what the server returns.
Raw JSON is never sent to the image model. The renderer writes sentences.
A lesson is one sentence, one fix, under 240 characters.
Memory stays under 24 active lessons and ~3,000 characters of active text.
Prompt packs stay under ~30 lines of rendered output.
File paths, field names, and CLI flags in the docs must match the code exactly.

tasks.title: Gemini API adapter
tasks.why: Turns a rendered prompt into a real image without copy-paste. Biggest single unlock for non-technical users.
steps: Add app/generate.mjs that POSTs to the Gemini image endpoint using process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY.
Accept { id, vars, settings_override } and return image bytes + prompt + cost.
Enforce a hard cap of 1 concurrent 4K request and a per-session spend ceiling from env.
Fail closed when the key is missing: never pretend an image was generated.
Add a CLI path: node tools/nbjson.mjs generate <template> --vars <file> --out <dir>.
acceptance: Key absent → clear error, exit code 1, nothing written.
Dry-run mode prints the prompt and estimated cost without calling out.
Spend ceiling blocks the 2nd 4K request when the cap is $0.30.
One test asserts the request body shape using a local stub server.
do_not: Do not commit keys, .env files, or signed URLs.
Do not silently retry on 429 without telling the user it cost money.

tasks.title: Per-client forks
tasks.why: Agencies need one memory per client. One folder per client beats one giant schema.
steps: Add tools/fork.mjs --client <slug> that copies templates/ + memory/ into clients/<slug>/.
Make MEMORY_PATH resolve from the current working directory when clients/<slug>/ is detected.
Add --client to render, add, score and stats.
Write clients/README.md explaining fork, sync, and never merge client lessons by hand.
acceptance: Two clients keep independent lesson scores in separate files.
Forking twice never overwrites an existing client folder without --force.
Existing single-folder behavior is unchanged; all 24 tests still pass.
do_not: Do not put client folders inside templates/.
Do not sync lessons automatically between clients.

tasks.title: Gallery of real outputs
tasks.why: Trust is visual. A strip of accepted images next to the prompt that made them sells the system instantly.
steps: Add gallery/ with <template-id>/<slug>.json holding { image, vars, prompt, verdict, lessons }.
Add GET /api/gallery that lists entries without loading full images.
Add a fourth view: a 3-column masonry strip, caption on hover, click opens image + prompt.
Store images at 1K and keep each file under 400 KB.
acceptance: Gallery renders with zero entries without an error state.
Each card shows the template, aspect ratio, and the lessons used.
Total repo size grows by less than 8 MB for 12 entries.
do_not: Do not show rejected images unless clearly labelled.

tasks.title: Design system hardening
tasks.why: The look is the first proof. It must survive edits by people who do not know why it works.
steps: Move every color, radius and type step into :root tokens. No raw hex outside :root.
Add a print stylesheet for the checklist view: black text, no cards, one page.
Verify keyboard order in all four views and a visible focus ring on every control.
Test at 320px, 768px, 1280px. Nothing scrolls sideways at any width.
acceptance: Contrast: body text at least 7:1 on its background; muted text at least 4.5:1.
No layout shift on load (reserve height for the prompt box).
Every interactive element reachable by Tab, in reading order.
do_not: Do not add a web font.
Do not add gradients to cards.
Do not animate anything on scroll.

tasks.title: First paid delivery SOP
tasks.why: Converts the system into revenue with a repeatable 3-day loop.
steps: Pick one niche with bad photos and repeatable products.
Send a 5-image free sample built from their own photos. No deck.
Quote per set, not per hour. Include one revision round and the delivery date.
Deliver a folder: images, the filled vars JSON, and a one-page style note.
Score every lesson used. Retire what did not help.
acceptance: Sample delivered within 24h of receiving photos.
Every delivered image passed the hands/eyes/digits check at 100%.
Client receives the vars file so they can re-run without you.
do_not: Do not promise exact text on labels you cannot read.
Do not deliver 4K before the client approves a 2K proof.

tasks.title: Quality gate before any PR
tasks.why: One sloppy commit undoes the impression the design buys.
steps: Run npm test and validate. Both must be clean, not 'mostly clean'.
Run the CLI help and diff the flags against the docs.
Open the app at 320px and 1280px. Click every control once.
Read the diff for invented claims, fake metrics, and placeholder lorem.
Check that no new dependency appeared in package.json.
acceptance: 0 failing tests, 0 validator errors, 0 broken links in docs.
No dependency added without an explicit reason in the PR body.
Every new claim in the docs is either sourced or labelled as an opinion.
do_not: Do not merge on 'it works on my machine'.
Do not accept 'TODO' in user-facing copy.
